# Emptying a locked grid region destroys the moved header button DOM and shifts GroupRow by 180px, and runtime column.locked splits a headerGroup across regions

## Context

During the Engine 13.4 release-gate verification matrix on `#20379` (*Grid columns can sit under a shared group header*, evaluated on `dev` at `ccb30d8d6e`), real-pointer Playwright + Neural Link testing on `examples/grid/headerGroups` surfaced critical layout/VDOM corruption when emptying a locked region after a prior header drag (`Row 4A`), group splitting when mutating `column.locked` at runtime (`Row 8`), and missing `"useAiClient": true` in `examples/grid/headerGroups/neo-config.json` (`Row 4` / `Row 7`).

## The Problem

Measured in Chromium + Neural Link on `examples/grid/headerGroups` (`dev` at `ccb30d8d6e`):

1. **Row 4A — Emptying `headerStart` / `headerEnd` after an earlier header drag (e.g. dragging `Region` from `locked: 'start'` into `center` after `Jan → Region`) loses the moved header button's DOM node and shifts all `center` group header cells by `180px`:**
   - When `Region` (`locked: 'start'`, `width: 180`) is dragged rightward and released over `May` (`center`) after an earlier header drag, `Region.locked` becomes `null`, emptying `lockedStartColumns` (`startEmptied = true` in `src/grid/header/Wrapper.mjs:297-325`).
   - Empirical result (`ROW_4D_REGION_TO_MAY`):
     - `headerStart` is destroyed, leaving 2 toolbars (`center` and `end`).
     - In the DOM, `toolbar0` (`center`) renders only `["Mar","Jan","Feb","Apr","May","Jun","Jul","Aug","Sep","Oct","Nov","Dec","Id"]` — **`Region`'s `<button>` DOM node is completely missing from the live DOM!**
     - Meanwhile, in the App Worker, `headerToolbar.items` and `body.columnPositions` *do* contain `region` (`x: 0, width: 180`).
     - Because `GroupRow#project()` places `Q1..Q4` from `body.columnPositions` (starting after `region` at `x: 180`), while the first rendered leaf button in the DOM (`Mar`) sits at `x: 0` (`rect.left = 1`), **every single centre group header cell is misaligned by `180px` from its leaves**:
       - `Q1`: `left: 181, right: 631` vs `leafLeft: 1, leafRight: 451` (`180px` offset!)
       - `Q2`: `left: 631, right: 1081` vs `leafLeft: 451, leafRight: 901` (`180px` offset!)
       - `Q3`: `left: 1081, right: 1531` vs `leafLeft: 901, leafRight: 1351` (`180px` offset!)
       - `Q4`: `left: 1531, right: 2359` vs `leafLeft: 1351, leafRight: 2359` (`180px` offset on left edge!)
2. **Row 8 — Runtime `column.locked` mutation (`onColumnLockChange`) on a grouped leaf splits its `headerGroup` across two regions:**
   - In multi-body grids (`BigDataMultiBodyNL` shape, `#9872` ground), changing `locked` at runtime on a grouped column via `app.setProperties(janColId, {locked: 'start'})` (or `column.locked = 'start'` / `responsiveLockPolicy`) invokes `grid.Container#onColumnLockChange(column)` (`src/grid/Container.mjs:1275-1313`).
   - Empirical result (`ROW_8_JAN_LOCKED_START`): `jan` moves to `lockedStartColumns` while `feb` and `mar` stay in `centerColumns`, **splitting `Q1` across two regions and rendering two separate `'Q1'` group header cells**:
     - `neo-grid-container-1__header-group-start`: `[{'text': 'Q1', 'colindex': '2', 'colspan': '1', 'left': 181, 'right': 331}]`
     - `neo-grid-container-1__header-group-center`: `[{'text': 'Q1', 'colindex': '3', 'colspan': '2', 'left': 331, 'right': 705}, ...]`
   - This violates `#20379`'s core invariant (*"so the group stays in one region"*).
3. **Row 4 & Row 7 Example Neural Link Surface (`examples/grid/headerGroups/neo-config.json`):**
   - `examples/grid/headerGroups/neo-config.json` lacks `"useAiClient": true` (unlike `examples/grid/lockedColumns/neo-config.json`), preventing direct Neural Link attachment without URL overrides.

## The Architectural Reality

- **Why `Region`'s DOM node disappears on a cross-parent move after an earlier update (`src/container/Base.mjs` `#insert`, verified by `@neo-opus-grace`):**
  1. On a fresh boot (with no prior header drag), `headerToolbar.updateDepth` is `-1` (an initial pending value), so `Region → May` emits `insertNode button → centre toolbar` followed by `removeNode` of `headerStart`, and `Region` survives.
  2. After *any* earlier update on `headerToolbar` (such as `Jan → Region`), `VdomLifecycle` resets `headerToolbar.updateDepth` to the class default (`1`).
  3. When `Container#insert` subsequently moves `button` across parents (`headerStart` → `headerToolbar`), its cross-parent path widens `updateDepth` only on the lowest common ancestor (`headerWrapper`), leaving the receiving container (`this` / `headerToolbar`) at `updateDepth: 1`.
  4. Boundary planning can emit the receiving `headerToolbar` as its own root at `updateDepth: 1`, where `TreeBuilder` prunes the newly inserted child (`button`) to a `{neoIgnore: true}` placeholder — so no `insertNode` delta is emitted for `button`, and the subsequent `removeNode` of the retired `headerStart` toolbar removes `button` from the live DOM!
  *(Initial intake hypothesis that `VNodeUtil.unlinkRetiredReferences` inlined the button's vnode was falsified by `@neo-opus-grace`: the retired vnode holds references only; widening the receiving container's `updateDepth` to `-1` on a cross-parent move in `src/container/Base.mjs` restores the `insertNode` delta.)*
- **Why runtime `column.locked` splits a group (`src/grid/Container.mjs:1275-1313`):**
  - `flattenColumns` (`src/grid/Container.mjs:1106-1116`) copies `entry.locked` onto every child column of a group at initial `columns` creation, and `SortZone#onDragEnd` (`SortZone.mjs:419-420`) keeps `column.locked` when a grouped leaf is dragged. However, `grid.Container#onColumnLockChange(column)` (`src/grid/Container.mjs:1275`) only re-sorts `me.columns` after a single `column.locked` setter fires, without synchronizing `locked` across sibling columns that share `column.headerGroup.id`.

Design authority: `#20379` (*Grid columns can sit under a shared group header*) + `#9872` (*Grid Multi-Body: 3-Tier Component Orchestration*) + 13.4 release-gate verification matrix (Rows 4 & 8).

## The Fix

1. **Widen the receiving container's `updateDepth` to `-1` on a cross-parent move in `Container#insert` (`src/container/Base.mjs`):**
   - When `Container#insert` moves a component from an old parent into a new parent (`this`), widen the receiving container's `updateDepth` to `-1` alongside the LCA so boundary planning and `TreeBuilder` expand the newly inserted child's vdom rather than pruning it to a `neoIgnore` placeholder at `updateDepth: 1`.
2. **Keep `headerGroup` columns in one region on runtime `column.locked` changes (`src/grid/Container.mjs:1275-1313`):**
   - In `grid.Container#onColumnLockChange(column)`, when `column.headerGroup` is present, propagate `column.locked` to every sibling column in `me.columns` sharing `column.headerGroup.id` before `sortColumns` / `onColumnsMutate` runs, so locking or unlocking any member of a group moves the entire group atomically to the target region.
3. **Enable `"useAiClient": true` in `examples/grid/headerGroups/neo-config.json`:**
   - Add `"useAiClient": true` to `examples/grid/headerGroups/neo-config.json` (matching `examples/grid/lockedColumns/neo-config.json`).

Decision Record impact: none.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] **AC-1 (Row 4A — Emptying a locked region after a prior drag preserves button DOM & group alignment):** After a prior header drag on `headerToolbar`, when the last ungrouped column in `headerStart` (`Region`) is dragged into `center`, its `.neo-grid-header-button` DOM node remains mounted in `headerToolbar` and every `.neo-grid-header-group-cell` aligns within `< 2px` of its first and last leaf button (unit + e2e).
- [ ] **AC-2 (Row 8 — Runtime `column.locked` is group-atomic):** Mutating `column.locked` at runtime on a grouped leaf (e.g. `column.locked = 'start'`) moves all leaves sharing `column.headerGroup.id` into the target region as a single group cell, never splitting the group across two regions (unit + e2e).
- [ ] **AC-3 (Example Neural Link config):** `examples/grid/headerGroups/neo-config.json` sets `"useAiClient": true`.

## Out of Scope

- **Adding a static `locked: 'start'` group to `examples/grid/headerGroups/MainContainer.mjs`:** Keeping `Region` as the sole `locked: 'start'` column on `examples/grid/headerGroups` is required so `AC-1` (dragging `Region` out to empty `headerStart`) and the shared column indices in `#20520` and `#20517` remain intact; adding a static `locked: 'start'` group beside `Region` on the fixture is split out to a separate leaf after `#20520`, `#20517`, and `#20511` merge (while runtime `locked: 'start'` group rendering is already exercised by `AC-2`).
- Within-toolbar `SortZone` swap guards (`#20510` / PR `#20520`) and cancelled drag body cell restore (`#20517`).
- Column resize on `flex` columns and live mid-drag `GroupRow#project()` (`#20512` / PR `#20514`).

## Avoided Traps

- **Widening only the LCA in `Container#insert` on a cross-parent move:** When the receiving container's `updateDepth` was reset to `1` by a previous update, boundary planning can emit the receiving container as its own update root at `depth: 1`, causing `TreeBuilder` to prune the newly moved child to `{neoIgnore: true}` and drop the `insertNode` delta.

* fix(grid): locking a grouped column moves its whole group (#20511)

grid.Container#onColumnLockChange re-sorted after a single column's
locked change, so locking one leaf of a header group at runtime split the
group across two regions (two cells for one group). A column under a
headerGroup now carries its locked to every sibling of the group before
the one re-sort. The siblings' own afterSetLocked re-entries return early
behind syncingGroupLock.

* fix(container): a component moved across parents renders in its new parent (#20511)

Container#insert flushes a cross-parent move at the lowest common
ancestor and widened only that ancestor's update depth. The receiving
container could still be a root of its own in that batch, at the depth
its previous update had reset it to, and then pruned the newcomer its
vnode did not hold yet, so the move never reached the DOM. Emptying a
grid's locked start region after any header drag hit it: the re-homed
header button died with the retired toolbar. The receiver now widens
too.

* chore(examples): the header groups example connects the Neural Link client (#20511)

As the locked-columns example does, so the release matrix can drive
examples/grid/headerGroups through the Neural Link."
